enrollment.title: Passkeys
enrollment.intro: Add a passkey (Touch ID, Windows Hello, or a security key) to sign in directly — fast and phishing-resistant, no password needed.
enrollment.secondFactorHint: Also ask for a passkey after every password sign-in. Off by default — enrolling a passkey on its own only enables direct passkey sign-in.
